purpose: Problem-family assimilation routines for M2D-SBA-22 after concept teaching and before Revised Core (2) transfer.

transfer_routines.title: Timed coordinate, then continue the flight
recognition_signals: wall or point reached at a stated time
both x and y coordinates are known at that event
question asks about a later part of the same flight

method_steps.title: Recover the vertical launch component
method_steps.learner_move: Use y_p=u_y t_p-1/2 g t_p^2 at the same event time.

method_steps.title: Build the total flight clock when landing is same-height
Continue the same flight after the event
method_steps.learner_move: Use T-t_p for remaining time and unchanged u_x for the remaining horizontal distance.

independent_practice.prompt: At t=1.5 s a projectile is at x=54 m and y=18.75 m. It later lands at the launch level. Take g=10 m/s^2. How far horizontally does it travel after that event before landing?
independent_practice.answer_check: u_x=36 m/s; u_y=20 m/s; T=4 s; remaining time=2.5 s; remaining horizontal distance=90 m.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: The marked point is an intermediate event. Its x, y and time reveal the launch components.

hint_ladder.label: First move
hint_ladder.prompt: Start with u_x=36 m/s, then solve the vertical event equation.

readiness_checks: write x and y at one shared event time
recover u_x and u_y without H2/H3
find T and continue the same flight using T-t_p
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q05 after 4/4 readiness without H2/H3.

transfer_routines.title: Time before P plus time after P
recognition_signals: time from launch to point P is given
time from P to same-height landing is also given
height or state at P is asked

method_steps.title: Build the total flight time
method_steps.learner_move: Add the time to P and the time from P to landing.

method_steps.title: Return to the event time from launch
method_steps.learner_move: Use t=t_to_P, not the remaining time.

method_steps.title: Evaluate the event state and check it
method_steps.learner_move: Use y=u_y t-1/2 gt^2 and compare t with T/2 to see whether P is before or after the apex.

independent_practice.prompt: A projectile reaches P 2 s after launch and lands back on the launch level 4 s after passing P. Take g=10 m/s^2. Find the height of P above the launch level.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: Both stated durations belong to one launch-to-landing flight. Build total T first.

hint_ladder.label: Representation
hint_ladder.prompt: T=2+4=6 s, so u_y=gT/2. Then use y=u_y t-1/2 gt^2 at t=2 s.

readiness_checks: add the two intervals to build T
evaluate y at the correct launch-based event time and sense-check against T/2
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q26 after 4/4 readiness without H2/H3.
